reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) demonstrates grain refinement and ductility improvement via hot rolling and rapid annealing in Ti-rich MEAs, but it does not address MnNiSi-based alloys, magnetocaloric effects, or the specific temperature window proposed. The key premise that the magnetocaloric effect is preserved is entirely unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Hot rolling refines grain size in the target alloy system
Rapid annealing after rolling recovers ductility without significant phase coarsening
Refined microstructure improves mechanical properties (ductility, toughness)
The magnetostructural transition and magnetocaloric effect are preserved after thermomechanical processing
The proposed temperature window (700–750 K rolling, 800 K annealing) is appropriate for MnNiSi-based alloys
